item.title: Attorney General Ellison’s Medicaid fraud unit executes search warrants at two locations
item.description:
Publication Date: October 29, 2026

Medicaid Fraud Control Unit agents join federal law enforcement this morning in executing search warrants at two autism-services entities in St. Louis Park and Edina

item.title: Attorney General Ellison wins $7.1M from General Motors for sharing drivers’ private data
item.description:
Publication Date: October 29, 2026

Settles allegations General Motors sold consumers’ private driver behavior data and location information to third parties, including data brokers who sold data to insurance companies
